$comment: Mirrors the Walk schema in src/walk-data.ts; change both together.
title: Tandem walk
description: A walk through the code, shown in the Walk view: explaining it, proposing changes to it, or both.

title.description: Names the walk. A new title starts the reader at step 1 with an empty review.

filePath.description: Path from the workspace root. Not absolute, and without "..".

id.description: Unique within the walk. Keep it when revising a step: the reader's place, approvals and responses follow it.

details.description: The longer explanation, shown on "Show more".

quote.description: Code from the file to highlight. Must appear there exactly once.

proposal.description: A change you intend to make, which the reader can approve.

diff.description: The intended change, in unified diff format. Proposals only.

quote.description: Code to select. Must appear in the file exactly once.
